name: Husqvarna 562 XP Mark II
blurb: 18″, 20″, 24″ and 28″ bar setups on 3/8″ chain, .050″ / .058″ / .063″ gauge, 68–93 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 562 XP Mark II is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 4 approved bar lengths for it (18″, 20″, 24″ and 28″), running 3/8″ pitch chain in .050″ / .058″ / .063″ gauge.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687468 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550068.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689168 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626968.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Tough 596687472 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550072 / C83S X-Cut 585551272 / C83SK X-Cut 585551472. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689172 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626972 / C85S X-Cut 585548972.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 24″ setup with bars X-Tough 596687484 / X-Tough Light 599656784 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550084 / C83S X-Cut 585551284 / C83SK X-Cut 585551484. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 24″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689184 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626984 / C85S X-Cut 585548984.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 28″ setup with bars X-Tough 596687493 / X-Tough Light 599656793 and chain C83 X-Cut 585550093 / C83S X-Cut 585551293 / C83SK X-Cut 585551493. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 28″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689193 and chain C85 X-Cut 581626993 / C85S X-Cut 585548993.

Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 28″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689693 and chain H83 591164093. One chain variant in the guide is a square-ground type that lists “Square” instead of a round-file size.
